findings.title: is_listable uses price > floor; spec rule 1 requires price >= floor (at-floor listing rejected)

README.md rule 1: 'a price at or above the listing floor is listable'
probe.py: is_listable(5.0, 5.0) = False (spec requires True)
test_pricer.py:18-21 test_listable_at_floor_exactly is @pytest.mark.skip - guarding test disabled

findings.title: round_cents uses builtin round (banker's rounding); spec rule 3 requires half-up
evidence: pricer.py:18 return round(amount, 2)
README.md rule 3: 'half up - 0.125 rounds to 0.13'
test_pricer.py:29-31 test_round_cents_half_up FAILED: assert 0.12 == 0.13
probe.py: round_cents(2.675)=2.67 (want 2.68), round_cents(0.145)=0.14 (want 0.15)
propagates into net_proceeds seller payouts

findings.title: bulk_unit_price does not reject negative prices; spec rule 5 violated
evidence: pricer.py:28-32 no price < 0 guard (is_listable and net_proceeds both guard)
README.md rule 5: 'Negative prices are rejected with a ValueError'
probe.py: bulk_unit_price(-5, 10) = -4.5; bulk_unit_price(-5, 3) = -5 (no error)
no test covers negative price for this function

findings.title: test_bulk_discount_applies seeds qty from time.time_ns() - nondeterministic, diagnosed
evidence: test_pricer.py:34-36 qty = 9 + (time.time_ns() // 1000) % 2; assert bulk_unit_price(20.00, qty) == 18.00
only holds for qty >= 10; mechanism fully diagnosed (time-seeded input) => BRITTLE_TEST not FLAKY per section 3
4/4 runs this session hit qty=9 -> FAILED assert 20.0 == 18.0
